ops.title: Eliminate duplicate full-list cache writes for indexed reads
ops.description: Owner: root. Natural installed 0.76.10 answer match/list calls wrote about 5.4 MiB; relevant-v6 contains similarly sized list payloads. Indexed reads duplicate per-tip fold payloads in a serialized full-list cache, invalidated after any selected tip changes. Next: hosted regression for fresh/unchanged/changed selected reads and complete snapshot semantics, remove redundant list persistence where warm read cost remains acceptable, independently review, merge/release/install and measure natural calls. No session replacement, no local load tests.

ops.text: Hosted fresh-process test demonstrates unchanged indexed reads write no cache data and one changed tip does not rewrite unrelated answer bodies; old 0.76.10 fails the regression
Existing indexed query semantics pass; hosted warm read costs measured and any regression resolved
Independently reviewed fix merged, released, installed without quarantine, and natural affected calls measured locally
